response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as overall_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT ga.ID, ga.avg_ana, ga.avg_ana - om.overall_avg as excess FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ga.avg_ana > om.overall_avg ORDER BY excess DESC, ga.ID ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Above the overall mean" is interpreted as strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal.

"Missing values last" in the sorting instruction most likely refers to NULL values in the excess column. Given the WHERE clause filtering for ga.avg_ana > om.overall_avg, no NULL excess values should occur in the result, but the descending sort will place any NULLs last by default.
